metadata.name: GetOFACInvestigationReport
metadata.description: The purpose of this API is to bring data of all the OFAC Suspicious Accounts which have the OFAC score equals to or greater than the Threshold defined at Institution.

request_fields.name: Source
request_fields.description: Source of API Consumer For external system expected sources will be WEB. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: IPAddress
request_fields.description: IP Address of Client / Application Hosting Server Example: 10.206.0.204 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: DateFormat
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Values are: 1 : MM/dd/yyyy HH:MM:SS (Default) 2 : MM/dd/yy HH:MM:SS 3 : dd/MM/yyyy HH:MM:SS Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: CurrencyCode
request_fields.description: Currency Code Place Holder for Future Use. Valid Values: Refer Appendix Section - Currency Code Example:840 = US Dollar Condition:If no value is passed, default value = 840 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CurrencySymbolType
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. CurrencySymbolType: 1: Currency Sign like $ 2: 3 ALPHA Currency Code like USD Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: Language
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Language: en: means use English Default: en - English Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: ExternalIP
request_fields.description: IP Address of end user of API Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: SessionID
request_fields.description: Session identifier of the API Example: 000028;026;1349906692 Allowable Values: 100

request_fields.name: APIVersion
request_fields.description: Version of the API to be invoked. Example: 2.0 API Version Current Version 2.0 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CallerID
request_fields.description: Caller ID of source from where API is initiated it is End User Caller ID Example: 7204454214 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: CalledID
request_fields.description: Called ID of destination for which API is initiated It is Destination Called ID Example: 7314145404 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: RequestTime
request_fields.description: Request Date Time of API Format: MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss Example:01/15/2020 10:05:23

request_fields.name: LastScanDate
request_fields.description: Previous Date on which Account screened  for OFAC as part of Bulk OFAC screening. Format:MM/DD/YYYY Example:12/20/2019

request_fields.name: InstitutionID
request_fields.description: Unique identification number for Institution Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXX Example:Fixed value needs to pass which is provided by Corecard.

response_fields.name: Status
response_fields.description: API Status Example: Success - true, Error - false

response_fields.name: ErrorCode
response_fields.description: Response Message Error Code Allowable Values: 10

children.name: OFACInvestigationReport
children.description: Array to show OFAC records which are matched/NotMatched with Insitituion threshold.

children.name: OFACScore
children.description: Threshold Score of OFAC set on Institution. Example:85 Allowable Values: 4

children.name: FirstName
children.description: Card holder's First name. Valid Values:A-Z Format:XXXXX Example:User1 Allowable Values: 50

children.name: MiddleName
children.description: Card holder's Middle Name Valid Values: A-Z Format:XXX Example: LEE Allowable Values: 40

children.name: LastName
children.description: Card holder's last name. Valid Values:A-Z Format:XXXXX Example:Smith Allowable Values: 80

children.name: AddressLine1
children.description: Debtor Address Line 1 Valid Values:A-Z, 0-9 Example:123 HWY Condition:This is mandatory only when HoldEmbossing tag value is 0(NO) Allowable Values: 50

children.name: AddressLine2
children.description: Debtor Address Line 2 Valid Values:A-Z,0-9 Example:Park Avenue Condition:This is mandatory only when HoldEmbossing tag value is 0(NO) and Country selected as Non-US. Allowable Values: 50

children.name: City
children.description: Debtor City Example:Los Angeles Condition: CBR Allowable Values: 25

children.name: State
children.description: State of the card holder address. Format:XXXXX Example: Virginia Allowable Values: 40

children.name: Country
children.description: Country name of the Card holder's address Example:USA Allowable Values: 3

children.name: AccountNumber
children.description: Debtor File # or Client Account # Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXXXXXXX Example:7314145404 Condition: At least one account identifier is required. Allowable Values: 19

children.name: MatchFlag
children.description: Flag to show if the record is Matched or Unmatched  basis Institution Threshold. Allowable Values: 10

children.name: AccountManualStatus
children.description: Manually assigned status on account Valid Values: Please refer 'AccountManualStatus' section of Swagger Appendix document. Example: 2 (Active): Allowable Values: 100

children.name: OFACClearanceDate
children.description: DateTime when the Account manually cleared from the OFAC status to Active status or to the status which was set before OFAC status. Format: MM/DD/YYYY HH:MM:SS Example:  02/02/2020  20:20:20

children.name: InstitutionThreshold
children.description: Threshold value which is set on Institution for OFAC check. Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 85 Allowable Values: 3

children.name: LastScanDate
children.description: Previous Date on which Account screened  for OFAC as part of Bulk OFAC screening. Format:MM/DD/YYYY Example:12/20/2019
